scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.check:api-generated: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-spec run check-generated && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-zod run test && tsc --build --force ./lib/api-client-react/tsconfig.json ./lib/api-zod/tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run audit:recovery && pnpm run check:api-generated && pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
